data.name: Exploratory Bone Health and Lipid Metabolism Objective
data.text: To evaluate the effect of LY4395089 on bone health and lipid metabolism in participants with CD

data.name: Exploratory Pharmacodynamic Objective
data.text: To evaluate the pharmacodynamic effects of LY4395089 in participants with CD

data.name: Exploratory Bone Health Biomarkers Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 and Week 40 of Study Period 2 in the following bone health biomarkers: CTX-1, PTH, P1NP, 25-OH-vitamin D, Bone-specific alkaline phosphatase

data.name: Exploratory Bone Mineral Density Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 for bone mineral density

data.name: Exploratory Lipid Metabolism Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 of Total cholesterol, TG, Non-HDL cholesterol, LDL, HDL

data.name: Exploratory Pharmacodynamic Biomarkers Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 in the following biomarkers: 7AlphaC4, FGF19

data.name: Primary Efficacy Estimand
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease meeting eligibility criteria as defined in the IIBD master protocol (Intent-to-Treat (ITT) Population as defined in the IIBD master protocol) Summary measure: As defined in the IIBD master protocol.

intercurrentEvents.name: Discontinuation of study treatment
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues LY4395089 and/or mirikizumab before the primary endpoint assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of prohibited concomitant medication
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant uses prohibited concomitant medications as defined in Appendix 14 of the IIBD master protocol

intercurrentEvents.name: Non-responder at Week 12
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not achieve endoscopic response or clinical response (by CDAI) at Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.analysisPopulation: Intent-to-Treat (ITT) Population as defined in the IIBD master protocol

data.summaryMeasure: As defined in the IIBD master protocol

data.name: Exploratory Bone Health Biomarkers Estimand
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease randomized in Study J6Z-MC-CD01, with available bone health biomarker assessments at baseline and post-baseline (All Randomized Population (Exploratory Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline (mean, standard deviation, median, min, max) at Week 12 of Study Period 1 and Week 40 of Study Period 2.

intercurrentEvents.name: Discontinuation of LY4395089
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues LY4395089 before Week 12 of Study Period 1 or Week 40 of Study Period 2 bone health biomarker assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of vitamin D or calcium supplementation
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant initiates or changes vitamin D or calcium supplementation during the study (lifestyle counseling for vitamin D/calcium is provided per SoA)

intercurrentEvents.name: Non-responder not entering Study Period 2
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant classified as non-responder at Week 12 of Study Period 1 and does not enter Study Period 2, resulting in missing Week 40 assessment

data.treatment: LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab alone
data.variableOfInterest: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 and Week 40 of Study Period 2 in bone health biomarkers (CTX-1, PTH, P1NP, 25-OH-vitamin D, Bone-specific alkaline phosphatase)
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline (mean, standard deviation, median, min, max) at Week 12 of Study Period 1 and Week 40 of Study Period 2

data.name: Exploratory Bone Mineral Density Estimand
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease randomized in Study J6Z-MC-CD01, with available DXA scan assessments at baseline and Week 12 of Study Period 1 (All Randomized Population (Exploratory Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline in bone mineral density (mean, standard deviation, median, min, max) at Week 12 of Study Period 1.

intercurrentEvents.name: Discontinuation of LY4395089 before Week 12 DXA scan
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues LY4395089 before the Week 12 bone mineral density DXA scan assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing DXA scan at Week 12
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not complete the DXA scan at Week 12 of Study Period 1 due to any reason including early discontinuation

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of bone-modifying agents
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant initiates bone-modifying agents (e.g., bisphosphonates) during Study Period 1 that may confound bone mineral density assessment

data.treatment: LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab alone
data.variableOfInterest: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 for bone mineral density as assessed by DXA scan
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline in bone mineral density (mean, standard deviation, median, min, max) at Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: Exploratory Lipid Metabolism Estimand
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease randomized in Study J6Z-MC-CD01, with available fasting lipid assessments at baseline and Week 12 of Study Period 1 (All Randomized Population (Exploratory Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline in fasting lipid parameters (mean, standard deviation, median, min, max) at Week 12 of Study Period 1.

intercurrentEvents.name: Discontinuation of LY4395089 before Week 12 lipid assessment
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues LY4395089 before the Week 12 fasting lipid assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Initiation of lipid-modifying therapy
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant initiates lipid-modifying therapy (e.g., statins, fibrates) during Study Period 1 that may confound lipid metabolism assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Non-fasting lipid sample
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not comply with fasting requirements prior to lipid sample collection at Week 12

data.treatment: LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab alone
data.variableOfInterest: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 in fasting lipid parameters: Total cholesterol, Triglycerides (TG), Non-HDL cholesterol, LDL cholesterol, HDL cholesterol
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline in fasting lipid parameters (mean, standard deviation, median, min, max) at Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: Exploratory Pharmacodynamic Biomarkers Estimand
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease randomized in Study J6Z-MC-CD01, with available pharmacodynamic biomarker assessments at baseline and Week 12 of Study Period 1 (All Randomized Population (Exploratory Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline in 7AlphaC4 and FGF19 (mean, standard deviation, median, min, max) at Week 12 of Study Period 1; individual concentration-time profiles may also be presented.

intercurrentEvents.name: Discontinuation of LY4395089 before Week 12 PD biomarker assessment
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues LY4395089 before the Week 12 pharmacodynamic biomarker assessment, resulting in absence of FXR agonism effect

intercurrentEvents.name: Missing pharmacodynamic biomarker sample at Week 12
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant does not provide a blood sample for 7AlphaC4 or FGF19 assessment at Week 12 of Study Period 1

intercurrentEvents.name: Use of medications affecting bile acid metabolism
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant initiates medications known to affect bile acid metabolism or FXR signaling (e.g., bile acid sequestrants) during Study Period 1

data.treatment: LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab alone
data.variableOfInterest: Change from baseline at Week 12 of Study Period 1 in pharmacodynamic biomarkers: 7AlphaC4 (bile acid synthesis marker) and FGF19 (fibroblast growth factor 19, FXR agonism marker)
data.summaryMeasure: Descriptive statistics of change from baseline in 7AlphaC4 and FGF19 (mean, standard deviation, median, min, max) at Week 12 of Study Period 1; individual concentration-time profiles may also be presented
